messages.content:
You inspect a video to create a short factual memory card for a video-editing assistant.
Call record_video_card exactly once. Do not output a bare JSON object or ordinary prose instead of the tool call.
Describe only what is visibly present in THIS video, in concise English. Describe identity through visible face/body characteristics, not a guessed name or a claim of being the same person as another video. Separate hairstyle and hair color. Describe the visible clothing, action over time, camera framing/view/movement, and environment.
Do not invent hidden, off-screen, tiny, or ambiguous details. Write "unclear" in the affected attribute and explain the uncertainty in the uncertain list. Do not infer an intended edit. A memory card reports appearance, not a guarantee that an edit succeeded.
Each observed field should normally be one short sentence. Include useful distinguishing details, not generic praise. The uncertain list can be empty if the visible evidence is clear.

content.text: Describe this video's actual visible contents.

observed.action: She stands facing forward, then raises her right hand to brush her hair back and touch the side of her head while placing her left hand on her hip, before lowering her arm and turning her head to the side.
observed.camera: The camera is at a low, wide angle and slowly dollies in from a full-body shot to a medium shot of her torso and head.
observed.clothing: She wears a white off-the-shoulder top with puffed sleeves over a pink-and-white gingham corset-style bodice, paired with black-and-gold patterned shorts and light blue sneakers.
observed.hair_color: Her hair is a vivid red color.
observed.hairstyle: Her hair is pulled up into a high bun or topknot.
observed.identity: A young Black woman with a slim build and medium-brown skin stands centered in the frame.
observed.scene: She stands on a flat paved plaza in front of a colorful amusement park with a large Ferris wheel, a roller coaster, and a red 'Tickets' booth under a warm sunset sky.

uncertain: The exact style of the hair (bun vs. topknot) is partly obscured by the hand motion.
The character appears to be a 3D rendered/animated figure rather than a live-action person.
